evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and changes CMake compiler checks, CI configuration, and dependencies documentation.
rationale: Bumps the minimum Clang version to 19 to enable C++20 CTAD on alias templates and drop workarounds for older compiler bugs. The author notes that 'most supported operating systems ship with clang-19 (or later), so bump the minimum to that and allow new code to drop workarounds for previous clang bugs', making this a routine compiler modernization step that can be deferred without blocking active development.
